freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 新模型 Ling-3.2-flash 于 2026-11-05 上线，上线前 2 周限时免费，活动结束后恢复按量计费（恢复后的价格以官网定价页为准）。平台另有每日 50 万 tokens 免费额度（含输入与输出，每日 02:00 前自动发放、当日未用不结转），Ling-3.1-flash 2.5 折、Ling-3.0-flash 与 Ling-3.0-flash-VL 2.8 折优惠中。Ling-3.2-flash 为 1M 上下文原生多模态模型（图像/文本/视频输入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议，全局 QPS 限 2；活动期限与折扣以官网定价页为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Ling-3.2-flash launched 2026-11-05 with a two-week free period; billing resumes after it (restored price per the pricing page). The platform also grants 500K free tokens per day (input plus output, credited before 02:00, no rollover) and discounts Ling-3.1-flash / Ling-3.0-flash. Ling-3.2-flash is a 1M-context multimodal model (image, text, video) with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols; QPS is 2.

zh-CN: 前往 API 控制台 https://chat.ant-ling.com/open 注册并登录蚂蚁百灵账号
在控制台完成支付宝账户绑定并开通百灵模型服务（未绑定则超出免费额度后调用暂停）
点击「创建令牌」生成 API Key，明文只展示一次，请立即保存
Base URL 填 https://api.ant-ling.com/v1，模型填 Ling-3.2-flash 即可调用；Anthropic 协议用 https://api.ant-ling.com/anthropic
Ling-3.2-flash 上线前 2 周限时免费，另有每日 50 万 tokens 免费额度，额度与活动期限以控制台和官网定价页为准
en: Sign up and log in to Ant Ling on the API console at https://chat.ant-ling.com/open
Link an Alipay account and activate the model service in the console (without it, calls stop once the free quota is used up)
Click "Create token" to generate an API key — the plaintext is shown once, save it immediately
Use https://api.ant-ling.com/v1 as the base URL with model Ling-3.2-flash; the Anthropic protocol uses https://api.ant-ling.com/anthropic
Ling-3.2-flash is free for the first two weeks after launch and the platform grants 500K free tokens daily; quotas and the promo window follow the console and the official pricing page
